name: Citrus
blurb: Bright, zesty peels. Usually the first thing you smell.

name: Fruits & nuts
blurb: Juicy, sweet flesh, from orchard fruit to tropical lychee.

name: Flowers
blurb: Petals of every kind: roses, orchids and wild native blooms.

name: White flowers
blurb: Heady, creamy blossoms that bloom at night and fill a room.

name: Greens & herbs
blurb: Leaves, stems and herbs. Fresh, crushed and a little bitter.

name: Spices
blurb: Warm or sharp, and the reason Singapore became a port.

name: Sweets & gourmand
blurb: Edible, dessert-like notes: vanilla, caramel, tonka.

name: Woods & mosses
blurb: Dry, deep and long-lasting. The base most perfumes sit on.

name: Resins & balsams
blurb: Sticky tree saps burned as incense for thousands of years.

name: Musk, amber & animalic
blurb: Soft, skin-like warmth, plus leather and suede.

name: Beverages
blurb: Drinks in a bottle: coffee, tea and the kopitiam counter.

name: Natural & synthetic
blurb: The air itself: sea spray, salt and water.
